decisions.reason: As a more peripheral consumer product with weaker strategic fit than the firm's industrial waste-to-value technologies, it is more likely to fall below aspirations and have its resources reallocated to core ventures.

These modular extensions fit the established engineering business and can be supported by the firm's growing R&D base, so behavioral-theory logic suggests tolerating uncertainty while they complement existing offerings.
Because it was treated as a flagship launch in the firm's core technological direction, management is likely to keep it on the market unless results are clearly far below aspiration levels.
Although commercialization risk is meaningful, its close fit with the firm's waste-conversion strategy and focal positioning make continued search and retention more likely than withdrawal.
